svg.title: Record: what is current, and what ended when
svg.desc: Record, as a log with columns since, state, what and detail. Now: innovation developer at Quokka, start not on record; Neon Sumi, hobby, open source, start not on record, tagged free in neon magenta because it wears its own design; drums, playing and recording since about 2009, dashed because the year is approximate. Ended: IT-högskolan, AI and ML coursework, 2022–2024.
